ephemeral_inline_signer.behavior: After exact helper readback and arming, reproduce one untouched native B6 trailer through ICU-S command 5; for each fresh nonzero C7 control sequence, replace B3..B9 of one already-admitted native B6 and install the locally generated valid trailer before stock SecOC consumption.

openpilot.warning: The working C7 integration was an uncommitted worktree delta on top of the listed opendbc base commit; the base commit by itself emitted direct zero-trailer B6 and is not the working configuration.

control_contract.active_sequence: 1..255, incremented for each latActive command; each value is consumed once
control_contract.panda_safety: Whitelist 0x1FDC0002/8 on bus0 and apply ordinary Toyota angle-command checks to B4:B5; reject malformed C7 headers.

required_lifecycle: Start from full EPS OFF, then enter NRTD/Park/stationary.
Transition directly NRTD to READY without OFF.
Run ./f33-secoc load-arm and require exact helper readback plus native Toyota trailer equality.
Return Panda ownership to one clean openpilot manager/pandad tree before driving.
Use the C7-enabled CarController and Panda safety files whose hashes are pinned above.
Full EPS OFF removes the resident and helper; repeat install/load-arm after every full power cycle.
operational_caveats: Entering EPS programming mode causes a Toyota system-malfunction state for the ignition cycle and disables TSS/DRCC longitudinal engagement.
The successful drive engaged openpilot after selecting normal non-adaptive cruise; stock TSS3 longitudinal was unavailable during that cycle.
A full vehicle restart restores DRCC but also removes the RAM resident.
A stale duplicate openpilot manager/pandad tree can leave sensord without IMU ownership and produce Sensor Data Invalid; run exactly one clean launch tree after returning the Panda lease.
The later bad-MAC stage-5 carrier admitted application data but did not produce steering; preserve the valid command-5 signer in the working fallback.
scope: This is the exact reproducible development fallback that produced observed steering. It is not the preferred native openpilot architecture and does not prove a stock 0x08A-to-B6 transform.
